verse.en: And they went out quickly from the sepulchre with fear and great joy, running to tell his disciples. And behold, Jesus met them, saying: All hail. But they came up and took hold of his feet and adored him.

celebration.en: Tuesday within the Octave of Easter
celebration.es: Martes de la Octava de Pascua

verse.en: But Mary stood at the sepulchre without, weeping.

celebration.en: Wednesday within the Octave of Easter
celebration.es: Miércoles de la Octava de Pascua

verse.en: And behold, two of them went, the same day, to a town which was sixty furlongs from Jerusalem, named Emmaus. And they talked together of all these things which had happened.

celebration.en: Thursday within the Octave of Easter
celebration.es: Jueves de la Octava de Pascua

verse.en: And they told what things were done in the way: and how they knew him in the breaking of bread. Now, whilst they were speaking these things, Jesus stood in the midst of them and saith to them: Peace be to you.

celebration.en: Friday within the Octave of Easter
celebration.es: Viernes de la Octava de Pascua

verse.en: After this, Jesus shewed himself again to the disciples at the sea of Tiberias. And he shewed himself after this manner.

celebration.en: Saturday within the Octave of Easter
celebration.es: Sábado de la Octava de Pascua

verse.en: But he rising early the first day of the week, appeared first to Mary Magdalen; out of whom he had cast seven devils. She went and told them that had been with him, who were mourning and weeping.

celebration.en: Second Sunday of Easter (or Sunday of Divine Mercy)
celebration.es: II Domingo de Pascua (Domingo de la Divina Misericordia)

verse.en: Now when it was late the same day, the first of the week, and the doors were shut, where the disciples were gathered together, for fear of the Jews, Jesus came and stood in the midst and said to them: Peace be to you.
And there was a man of the Pharisees, named Nicodemus, a ruler of the Jews.
And he said to them: Go ye into the whole world and preach the gospel to every creature. He that believeth and is baptized shall be saved: but he that believeth not shall be condemned.
For God so loved the world, as to give his only begotten Son: that whosoever believeth in him may not perish, but may have life everlasting.
He that cometh from above is above all. He that is of the earth, of the earth he is, and of the earth he speaketh. He that cometh from heaven is above all.
After these things Jesus went over the sea of Galilee, which is that of Tiberias. And a great multitude followed him, because they saw the miracles which he did on them that were diseased.

celebration.en: Saint Catherine of Siena, Virgin and Doctor of the Church
celebration.es: Santa Catalina de Siena, virgen y doctora de la Iglesia

verse.en: And when evening was come, his disciples went down to the sea. And when they had gone up into a ship, they went over the sea to Capharnaum. And it was now dark: and Jesus was not come unto them.
After this, Jesus shewed himself again to the disciples at the sea of Tiberias. And he shewed himself after this manner.
The next day, the multitude that stood on the other side of the sea saw that there was no other ship there but one: and that Jesus had not entered into the ship with his disciples…

celebration.en: Saint Athanasius, Bishop and Doctor of the Church
celebration.es: San Atanasio, obispo y doctor de la Iglesia

verse.en: They said therefore to him: What sign therefore dost thou shew that we may see and may believe thee? What dost thou work? Our fathers did eat manna in the desert, as it is written: He gave them bread from heaven to eat.

Jesus saith to him: I am the way, and the truth, and the life. No man cometh to the Father, but by me. If you had known me, you would without doubt have known my Father also: and from henceforth you shall know him.
No man can come to me, except the Father, who hath sent me, draw him. And I will raise him up in the last day. It is written in the prophets: And they shall all be taught of God.
The Jews therefore strove among themselves, saying: How can this man give us his flesh to eat?
Many therefore of his disciples, hearing it, said: This saying is hard; and who can hear it? But Jesus, knowing in himself that his disciples murmured at this, said to them: Doth this scandalize you?
My sheep hear my voice. And I know them: and they follow me. And I give them life everlasting: and they shall not perish for ever. And no man shall pluck them out of my hand.

Amen, amen, I say to you: He that entereth not by the door into the sheepfold but climbeth up another way, the same is a thief and a robber. But he that entereth in by the door is the shepherd of the sheep.
And it was the feast of the dedication at Jerusalem: and it was winter. And Jesus walked in the temple, in Solomon’s porch.
But Jesus cried and said: He that believeth in me doth not believe in me, but in him that sent me. And he that seeth me, seeth him that sent me.
Amen, amen, I say to you: The servant is not greater than his lord: neither is the apostle greater than he that sent him. If you know these things, you shall be blessed if you do them.
Let not your heart be troubled. You believe in God: believe also in me. In my Father’s house there are many mansions. If not, I would have told you: because I go to prepare a place for you.

If you had known me, you would without doubt have known my Father also: and from henceforth you shall know him. And you have seen him. Philip saith to him: Lord, shew us the Father; and it is enough for us.

When he therefore was gone out, Jesus said: Now is the Son of man glorified; and God is glorified in him. If God be glorified in him, God also will glorify him in himself: and immediately will he glorify him.
He that hath my commandments and keepeth them; he it is that loveth me. And he that loveth me shall be loved of my Father: and I will love him and will manifest myself to him.

Peace I leave with you: my peace I give unto you: not as the world giveth, do I give unto you. Let not your heart be troubled: nor let it be afraid. You have heard that I said to you: I go away, and I come unto you.

I am the true vine: and my Father is the husbandman. Every branch in me that beareth not fruit, he will take away: and every one that beareth fruit, he will purge it, that it may bring forth more fruit.
As the Father hath loved me, I also have loved you. Abide in my love. If you keep my commandments, you shall abide in my love: as I also have kept my Father’s commandments and do abide in his love.

This is my commandment, that you love one another, as I have loved you. Greater love than this no man hath, that a man lay down his life for his friends. You are my friends, if you do the things that I command you.
If the world hate you, know ye that it hath hated me before you.

Jesus answered and said to him: If any one love me, he will keep my word. And my Father will love him and we will come to him and will make our abode with him. He that loveth me not keepeth not my words.
But when the Paraclete cometh, whom I will send you from the Father, the Spirit of truth, who proceedeth from the Father, he shall give testimony of me.

And now I go to him that sent me, and none of you asketh me: Whither goest thou? But because I have spoken these things to you, sorrow hath filled your heart. But I tell you the truth: it is expedient to you that I go.
I have yet many things to say to you: but you cannot bear them now. But when he, the Spirit of truth, is come, he will teach you all truth.
A little while, and now you shall not see me: and again a little while, and you shall see me: because I go to the Father.
Amen, amen, I say to you, that you shall lament and weep, but the world shall rejoice: and you shall be made sorrowful, but your sorrow shall be turned into joy.
And in that day you shall not ask me any thing. Amen, amen, I say to you: if you ask the Father any thing in my name, he will give it you. Hitherto, you have not asked any thing in my name.

And he said to them: Thus it is written, and thus it behoved Christ to suffer and to rise again from the dead, the third day: And that penance and remission of sins should be preached in his name, unto all nations…
His disciples say to him: Behold, now thou speakest plainly and speakest no proverb. Now we know that thou knowest all things and thou needest not that any man should ask thee.
These things Jesus spoke: and lifting up his eyes to heaven, he said: Father, the hour is come. Glorify thy Son, that thy Son may glorify thee.

celebration.en: The Visitation of the Blessed Virgin Mary
celebration.es: Visitación de la Bienaventurada Virgen María

verse.en: And Mary rising up in those days, went into the hill country with haste into a city of Juda. And she entered into the house of Zachary and saluted Elizabeth.
And not for them only do I pray, but for them also who through their word shall believe in me.

When therefore they had dined, Jesus saith to Simon Peter: Simon, son of John, lovest thou me more than these? He saith to him: Yea, Lord, thou knowest that I love thee. He saith to him: Feed my lambs.

celebration.en: Saint Charles Lwanga and Companions, Martyrs
celebration.es: Santos Carlos Lwanga y compañeros, mártires

verse.en: Peter turning about, saw that disciple whom Jesus loved following, who also leaned on his breast at supper and said: Lord, who is he that shall betray thee?

Now when it was late the same day, the first of the week, and the doors were shut, where the disciples were gathered together, for fear of the Jews, Jesus came and stood in the midst and said to them: Peace be to you.

celebration.en: The Blessed Virgin Mary, Mother of the Church
celebration.es: Bienaventurada Virgen María, Madre de la Iglesia

verse.en: Now there stood by the cross of Jesus, his mother and his mother’s sister, Mary of Cleophas, and Mary Magdalen.
And they sent to him some of the Pharisees and of the Herodians: that they should catch him in his words.
And there came to him the Sadducees, who say there is no resurrection.
And there came one of the scribes that had heard them reasoning together, and seeing that he had answered them well, asked him which was the first commandment of all.
And Jesus answering, said, teaching in the temple: How do the scribes say that Christ is the son of David?
And he said to them in his doctrine: Beware of the scribes, who love to walk in long robes and to be saluted in the marketplace…
I have yet many things to say to you: but you cannot bear them now. But when he, the Spirit of truth, is come, he will teach you all truth.
And seeing the multitudes, he went up into a mountain, and when he was set down, his disciples came unto him.

celebration.en: Saint Anthony of Padua, Priest and Doctor of the Church
celebration.es: San Antonio de Padua, presbítero y doctor de la Iglesia

verse.en: You are the salt of the earth. But if the salt lose its savour, wherewith shall it be salted? It is good for nothing anymore but to be cast out, and to be trodden on by men. You are the light of the world.
Do not think that I am come to destroy the law, or the prophets. I am not come to destroy, but to fulfil.

For I tell you, that unless your justice abound more than that of the scribes and Pharisees, you shall not enter into the kingdom of heaven. You have heard that it was said to them of old: Thou shalt not kill.

You have heard that it was said to them of old: Thou shalt not commit adultery. But I say to you, that whosoever shall look on a woman to lust after her, hath already committed adultery with her in his heart.
Again you have heard that it was said to them of old, thou shalt not forswear thyself: but thou shalt perform thy oaths to the Lord.

celebration.en: The Most Holy Body and Blood of Christ (Corpus Christi)
celebration.es: Santísimo Cuerpo y Sangre de Cristo (Corpus Christi)

verse.en: Which when the people knew, they followed him: and he received them and spoke to them of the kingdom of God and healed them who had need of healing. Now the day began to decline.
You have heard that it hath been said: An eye for an eye, and a tooth for a tooth.
You have heard that it hath been said, Thou shalt love thy neighbour, and hate thy enemy.
Take heed that you do not your justice before men, to be seen by them: otherwise you shall not have a reward of your Father who is in heaven.
And when you are praying, speak not much, as the heathens. For they think that in their much speaking they may be heard.

celebration.en: The Most Sacred Heart of Jesus

verse.en: And he spoke to them this parable, saying: What man of you that hath an hundred sheep, and if he shall lose one of them, doth he not leave the ninety-nine in the desert and go after that which was lost, until he find it?

celebration.en: The Nativity of Saint John the Baptist

verse.en: Now Elizabeth’s full time of being delivered was come: and she brought forth a son. And her neighbors and kinsfolks heard that the Lord had shewed his great mercy towards her: and they congratulated with her.
And it came to pass, as he was alone praying, his disciples also were with him: and he asked them, saying: Whom do the people say that I am?
Judge not, that you may not be judged. For with what judgment you judge, you shall be judged: and with what measure you mete, it shall be measured to you again.
Give not that which is holy to dogs; neither cast ye your pearls before swine, lest perhaps they trample them under their feet, and turning upon you, they tear you.

celebration.en: Saint Irenaeus, Bishop, Martyr, and Doctor of the Church
celebration.es: San Ireneo, obispo, mártir y doctor de la Iglesia

verse.en: Beware of false prophets, who come to you in the clothing of sheep, but inwardly they are ravening wolves. By their fruits you shall know them. Do men gather grapes of thorns, or figs of thistles?
And Jesus came into the quarters of Cesarea Philippi: and he asked his disciples, saying: Whom do men say that the Son of man is?
And when he was come down from the mountain, great multitudes followed him: And behold a leper came and adored him, saying: Lord, if thou wilt, thou canst make me clean.
And when he had entered into Capharnaum, there came to him a centurion, beseeching him, And saying, Lord, my servant lieth at home sick of the palsy, and is grievously tormented.
And it came to pass, when the days of his assumption were accomplishing, that he steadfastly set his face to go to Jerusalem.
Now Thomas, one of the twelve, who is called Didymus, was not with them when Jesus came. The other disciples therefore said to him: We have seen the Lord.
And when he entered into the boat, his disciples followed him: And behold a great tempest arose in the sea, so that the boat was covered with waves, but he was asleep.
And when he was come on the other side of the water, into the country of the Gerasens, there met him two that were possessed with devils, coming out of the sepulchres, exceeding fierce…
And entering into a boat, he passed over the water and came into his own city. And behold they brought to him one sick of the palsy lying in a bed.
And when Jesus passed on from thence, he saw a man sitting in the custom house, named Matthew; and he saith to him: Follow me. And he arose up and followed him.
Then came to him the disciples of John, saying: Why do we and the Pharisees, fast often, but thy disciples do not fast?
And after these things, the Lord appointed also other seventy-two. And he sent them two and two before his face into every city and place whither he himself was to come.
As he was speaking these things unto them, behold a certain ruler came up, and adored him, saying: Lord, my daughter is even now dead; but come, lay thy hand upon her, and she shall live.

And when they were gone out, behold they brought him a dumb man, possessed with a devil. And after the devil was cast out, the dumb man spoke, and the multitudes wondered, saying, Never was the like seen in Israel.
And having called his twelve disciples together, he gave them power over unclean spirits, to cast them out, and to heal all manner of diseases, and all manner of infirmities.
And going, preach, saying: The kingdom of heaven is at hand. Heal the sick, raise the dead, cleanse the lepers, cast out devils: freely have you received, freely give.

Behold I send you as sheep in the midst of wolves. Be ye therefore wise as serpents and simple as doves. But beware of men. For they will deliver you up in councils, and they will scourge you in their synagogues.

celebration.en: Saint Bonaventure, Bishop and Doctor of the Church
celebration.es: San Buenaventura, obispo y doctor de la Iglesia

verse.en: The disciple is not above the master, nor the servant above his lord. It is enough for the disciple that he be as his master, and the servant as his lord.
And behold a certain lawyer stood up, tempting him and saying, Master, what must I do to possess eternal life? But he said to him: What is written in the law? How readest thou?
Do not think that I came to send peace upon earth: I came not to send peace, but the sword.
Then began he to upbraid the cities wherein were done the most of his miracles, for that they had not done penance.
At that time Jesus answered and said: I confess to thee, O Father, Lord of Heaven and earth, because thou hast hid these things from the wise and prudent, and hast revealed them to little ones.
Come to me all you that labor and are burdened, and I will refresh you. Take up my yoke upon you, and learn of me, because I am meek, and humble of heart: And you shall find rest to your souls.
At that time Jesus went through the corn on the sabbath: and his disciples being hungry, began to pluck the ears, and to eat.
And on the first day of the week, Mary Magdalen cometh early, when it was yet dark, unto the sepulchre: and she saw the stone taken away from the sepulchre.
Now it came to pass, as they went, that he entered into a certain town: and a certain woman named Martha received him into her house.
Then some of the scribes and Pharisees answered him, saying: Master, we would see a sign from thee.
Then came to him the mother of the sons of Zebedee with her sons, adoring and asking something of him. Who said to her: What wilt thou?

celebration.en: Saints Joachim and Anne, Parents of the Blessed Virgin Mary
celebration.es: Santos Joaquín y Ana, padres de la Bienaventurada Virgen María

verse.en: The same day Jesus going out of the house, sat by the sea side. And great multitudes were gathered together unto him, so that he went up into a boat and sat: and all the multitude stood on the shore.

And his disciples came and said to him: Why speakest thou to them in parables? Who answered and said to them: Because to you it is given to know the mysteries of the kingdom of heaven: but to them it is not given.
Hear you therefore the parable of the sower.
And many of the Jews were come to Martha and Mary, to comfort them concerning their brother. Martha therefore, as soon as she heard that Jesus was come, went to meet him: but Mary sat at home.
And it came to pass that as he was in a certain place praying, when he ceased, one of his disciples said to him: Lord, teach us to pray, as John also taught his disciples.
Another parable he proposed unto them, saying: The kingdom of heaven is like to a grain of mustard seed, which a man took and sowed in his field.

celebration.en: Saint Alphonsus Liguori, Bishop and Doctor of the Church
celebration.es: San Alfonso María de Ligorio, obispo y doctor de la Iglesia

verse.en: Then having sent away the multitudes, he came into the house, and his disciples came to him, saying: Expound to us the parable of the cockle of the field.
The kingdom of heaven is like unto a treasure hidden in a field. Which a man having found, hid it, and for joy thereof goeth, and selleth all that he hath, and buyeth that field.
Again the kingdom of heaven is like to a net cast into the sea, and gathering together of all kinds of fishes.
And coming into his own country, he taught them in their synagogues, so that they wondered and said: How came this man by this wisdom and miracles? Is not this the carpenter’s son?
At that time Herod the Tetrarch heard the fame of Jesus. And he said to his servants: This is John the Baptist: he is risen from the dead, and therefore mighty works shew forth themselves in him.
And it came to pass, about eight days after these words, that he took Peter and James and John and went up into a mountain to pray.
Which when Jesus had heard, he retired from thence by a boat, into a desert place apart, and the multitudes having heard of it, followed him on foot out of the cities.

And forthwith Jesus obliged his disciples to go up into the boat, and to go before him over the water, till he dismissed the people. And having dismissed the multitude, he went into a mountain alone to pray.
And Jesus went from thence, and retired into the coasts of Tyre and Sidon.
Amen, amen, I say to you, unless the grain of wheat falling into the ground die, Itself remaineth alone. But if it die it bringeth forth much fruit.
Then Jesus said to his disciples: If any man will come after me, let him deny himself, and take up his cross, and follow me.

And when he was come to the multitude, there came to him a man falling down on his knees before him saying: Lord, have pity on my son, for he is a lunatic, and suffereth much: for he falleth often into the fire…
Fear not, little flock, for it hath pleased your Father to give you a kingdom. Sell what you possess and give alms.

celebration.en: Saint Maximilian Kolbe, Priest and Martyr
celebration.es: San Maximiliano María Kolbe, presbítero y mártir

verse.en: And when they abode together in Galilee, Jesus said to them: The Son of man shall be betrayed into the hands of men: And they shall kill him, and the third day he shall rise again. And they were troubled exceedingly.

celebration.en: The Assumption of the Blessed Virgin Mary
celebration.es: Asunción de la Bienaventurada Virgen María

verse.en: And Mary rising up in those days, went into the hill country with haste into a city of Juda. And she entered into the house of Zachary and saluted Elizabeth.
But if thy brother shall offend against thee, go, and rebuke him between thee and him alone. If he shall hear thee, thou shalt gain thy brother.

Then came Peter unto him and said: Lord, how often shall my brother offend against me, and I forgive him? till seven times? Jesus saith to him: I say not to thee, till seven times; but till seventy times seven times.
And there came to him the Pharisees tempting him, saying: Is it lawful for a man to put away his wife for every cause?
Then were little children presented to him, that he should impose hands upon them and pray. And the disciples rebuked them.
I am come to cast fire on the earth. And what will I, but that it be kindled? And I have a baptism wherewith I am to be baptized. And how am I straitened until it be accomplished?
And behold one came and said to him: Good master, what good shall I do that I may have life everlasting? Who said to him: Why askest thou me concerning good? One is good, God.

celebration.en: The Queenship of the Blessed Virgin Mary

verse.en: Then Jesus said to his disciples: Amen, I say to you, that a rich man shall hardly enter into the kingdom of heaven.

The kingdom of heaven is like to an householder, who went out early in the morning to hire labourers into his vineyard. And having agreed with the labourers for a penny a day, he sent them into his vineyard.

Philip findeth Nathanael and saith to him: We have found him of whom Moses, in the law and the prophets did write, Jesus the son of Joseph of Nazareth. And Nathanael said to him: Can any thing of good come from Nazareth?
But the Pharisees, hearing that he had silenced the Sadducees, came together. And one of them, a doctor of the law, asked him, tempting him: Master, which is the great commandment in the law?
Then Jesus spoke to the multitudes and to his disciples, Saying: The scribes and the Pharisees have sitten on the chair of Moses.
And he went through the cities and towns teaching and making his journey to Jerusalem. And a certain man said to him: Lord, are they few that are saved?

celebration.en: Saint Augustine, Bishop and Doctor of the Church
celebration.es: San Agustín, obispo y doctor de la Iglesia

verse.en: But woe to you, scribes and Pharisees, hypocrites, because you shut the kingdom of heaven against men: for you yourselves do not enter in and those that are going in, you suffer not to enter.

celebration.en: The Passion of Saint John the Baptist

verse.en: For Herod himself had sent and apprehended John, and bound him in prison for the sake of Herodias the wife of Philip his brother, because he had married her.
Woe to you, scribes and Pharisees, hypocrites; because you are like to whited sepulchres, which outwardly appear to men beautiful but within are full of dead men’s bones and of all filthiness.
Watch ye therefore, because you know not what hour your Lord will come.
Then shall the kingdom of heaven be like to ten virgins, who taking their lamps went out to meet the bridegroom and the bride. And five of them were foolish and five wise.

For even as a man going into a far country called his servants and delivered to them his goods; And to one he gave five talents, and to another two, and to another one, to every one according to his proper ability…
And it came to pass, when Jesus went into the house of one of the chief of the Pharisees, on the sabbath day, to eat bread, that they watched him.

And he came to Nazareth, where he was brought up: and he went into the synagogue, according to his custom, on the sabbath day: and he rose up to read. And the book of Isaias the prophet was delivered unto him.
And he went down into Capharnaum, a city of Galilee: and there he taught them on the sabbath days. And they were astonished at his doctrine: for his speech was with power.

And Jesus rising up out of the synagogue, went into Simon’s house. And Simon’s wife’s mother was taken with a great fever: and they besought him for her. And standing over her, he commanded the fever: and it left her.
And it came to pass, that when the multitudes pressed upon him to hear the word of God, he stood by the lake of Genesareth, And saw two ships standing by the lake…

celebration.en: The Nativity of the Blessed Virgin Mary
celebration.es: Natividad de la Bienaventurada Virgen María

verse.en: The book of the generation of Jesus Christ, the son of David, the son of Abraham: Abraham begot Isaac. And Isaac begot Jacob. And Jacob begot Judas and his brethren. And Judas begot Phares and Zara of Thamar.
And it came to pass on the second first sabbath that, as he went through the corn fields, his disciples plucked the ears and did eat, rubbing them in their hands.
And there went great multitudes with him.
And it came to pass also, on another sabbath, that he entered into the synagogue and taught. And there was a man whose right hand was withered.
And it came to pass in those days, that he went out into a mountain to pray: and he passed the whole night in the prayer of God.

celebration.en: Saint John Chrysostom, Bishop and Doctor of the Church
celebration.es: San Juan Crisóstomo, obispo y doctor de la Iglesia

verse.en: And he, lifting up his eyes on his disciples, said: Blessed are ye poor: for yours is the kingdom of God. Blessed are ye that hunger now: for you shall be filled. Blessed are ye that weep now: for you shall laugh.

celebration.en: The Exaltation of the Holy Cross

verse.en: And no man hath ascended into heaven, but he that descended from heaven, the Son of man who is in heaven.

celebration.es: Bienaventurada Virgen María de los Dolores

verse.en: Now there stood by the cross of Jesus, his mother and his mother’s sister, Mary of Cleophas, and Mary Magdalen.

celebration.en: Saints Cornelius, Pope, and Cyprian, Bishop, Martyrs
celebration.es: Santos Cornelio, Papa, y Cipriano, obispo, mártires

verse.en: For there is no good tree that bringeth forth evil fruit: nor an evil tree that bringeth forth good fruit. For every tree is known by its fruit.
Now the publicans and sinners drew near unto him to hear him. And the Pharisees and the scribes murmured, saying: This man receiveth sinners and eateth with them.
And when he had finished all his words in the hearing of the people, he entered into Capharnaum. And the servant of a certain centurion who was dear to him, being sick, was ready to die.
And it came to pass afterwards that he went into a city that is called Naim: and there went with him his disciples and a great multitude.

celebration.en: Saints Andrew Kim Tae-gŏn, Priest, and Paul Chŏng Ha-sang, and Companions, Martyrs
celebration.es: Santos Andrés Kim Tae-gŏn, presbítero, Pablo Chŏng Ha-sang y compañeros, mártires

verse.en: And the Lord said: Whereunto then shall I liken the men of this generation? And to what are they like?
And when Jesus passed on from thence, he saw a man sitting in the custom house, named Matthew; and he saith to him: Follow me. And he arose up and followed him.
And it came to pass afterwards, that he travelled through the cities and towns, preaching and evangelizing the kingdom of God: and the twelve with him…

And when a very great multitude was gathered together and hastened out of the cities, unto him, he spoke by a similitude. The sower went out to sow his seed. And as he sowed, some fell by the way side.

And he said also to his disciples: There was a certain rich man who had a steward: and the same was accused unto him, that he had wasted his goods. And he called him and said to him: How is it that I hear this of thee?
Now no man lighting a candle covereth it with a vessel or putteth it under a bed: but setteth it upon a candlestick, that they who come in may see the light.
And his mother and brethren came unto him: and they could not come at him for the crowd. And it was told him: Thy mother and thy brethren stand without, desiring to see thee.
Then calling together the twelve apostles, he gave them power and authority over all devils and to cure diseases. And he sent them to preach the kingdom of God and to heal the sick.
Now Herod, the tetrarch, heard of all things that were done by him.

celebration.en: Saints Michael, Gabriel and Raphael, Archangels
celebration.es: Santos arcángeles Miguel, Gabriel y Rafael

verse.en: Jesus saw Nathanael coming to him and he saith of him: Behold an Israelite indeed, in whom there is no guile. Nathanael saith to him: Whence knowest thou me?

celebration.en: Saint Jerome, Priest and Doctor of the Church
celebration.es: San Jerónimo, presbítero y doctor de la Iglesia

verse.en: And all were astonished at the mighty power of God.
There was a certain rich man who was clothed in purple and fine linen and feasted sumptuously every day.
At that hour the disciples came to Jesus, saying: Who, thinkest thou, is the greater in the kingdom of heaven? And Jesus, calling unto him a little child, set him in the midst of them.
And it came to pass, when the days of his assumption were accomplishing, that he steadfastly set his face to go to Jerusalem.
And it came to pass, as they walked in the way, that a certain man said to him: I will follow thee whithersoever thou goest.
And after these things, the Lord appointed also other seventy-two. And he sent them two and two before his face into every city and place whither he himself was to come.

Woe to thee, Corozain! Woe to thee, Bethsaida! For if in Tyre and Sidon had been wrought the mighty works that have been wrought in you, they would have done penance long ago, sitting in sackcloth and ashes.
And the seventy-two returned with joy, saying: Lord, the devils also are subject to us in thy name. And he said to them: I saw Satan like lightning falling from heaven.

And the apostles said to the Lord: Increase our faith. And the Lord said: If you had faith like to a grain of mustard seed, you might say to this mulberry tree: Be thou rooted up and be thou transplanted into the sea.
And behold a certain lawyer stood up, tempting him and saying, Master, what must I do to possess eternal life? But he said to him: What is written in the law? How readest thou?
Now it came to pass, as they went, that he entered into a certain town: and a certain woman named Martha received him into her house.
And it came to pass that as he was in a certain place praying, when he ceased, one of his disciples said to him: Lord, teach us to pray, as John also taught his disciples.
And he said to them: Which of you shall have a friend and shall go to him at midnight and shall say to him: Friend, lend me three loaves…
But some of them said: He casteth out devils by Beelzebub, the prince of devils. And others tempting, asked of him a sign from heaven.
And it came to pass, as he spoke these things, a certain woman from the crowd, lifting up her voice, said to him: Blessed is the womb that bore thee and the paps that gave thee suck.

And it came to pass, as he was going to Jerusalem, he passed through the midst of Samaria and Galilee. And as he entered into a certain town, there met him ten men that were lepers, who stood afar off.
And the multitudes running together, he began to say: This generation is a wicked generation. It asketh a sign: and a sign shall not be given it, but the sign of Jonas the prophet.

celebration.en: Saint Ignatius of Antioch, Bishop and Martyr
celebration.es: San Ignacio de Antioquía, obispo y mártir

verse.en: And as he was speaking, a certain Pharisee prayed him that he would dine with him. And he going in, sat down to eat. And the Pharisee began to say, thinking within himself, why he was not washed before dinner.
And after these things, the Lord appointed also other seventy-two. And he sent them two and two before his face into every city and place whither he himself was to come.

celebration.en: Saints John de Brébeuf and Isaac Jogues, Priests, and Companions, Martyrs
celebration.es: Santos Juan de Brébeuf e Isaac Jogues, presbíteros, y compañeros, mártires

verse.en: Woe to you who build the monuments of the prophets: and your fathers killed them. Truly you bear witness that you consent to the doings of your fathers. For they indeed killed them: and you build their sepulchres.
And when great multitudes stood about him, so that they trod one upon another, he began to say to his disciples: Beware ye of the leaven of the Pharisees, which is hypocrisy.
And I say to you: Whosoever shall confess me before men, him shall the Son of man also confess before the angels of God. But he that shall deny me before men shall be denied before the angels of God.
And he spoke also a parable to them, that we ought always to pray and not to faint, Saying: There was a judge in a certain city, who feared not God nor regarded man.
And one of the multitude said to him: Master, speak to my brother that he divide the inheritance with me. But he said to him: Man, who hath appointed me judge or divider over you?

Let your loins be girt and lamps burning in your hands. And you yourselves like to men who wait for their lord, when he shall return from the wedding; that when he cometh and knocketh, they may open to him immediately.
But this know ye, that if the householder did know at what hour the thief would come, he would surely watch and would not suffer his house to be broken open.
I am come to cast fire on the earth. And what will I, but that it be kindled? And I have a baptism wherewith I am to be baptized. And how am I straitened until it be accomplished?

And he said also to the multitudes: When you see a cloud rising from the west, presently you say: A shower is coming. And so it happeneth. And when ye see the south wind blow, you say: There will be heat.
And it came to pass in those days, that he went out into a mountain to pray: and he passed the whole night in the prayer of God.
And to some who trusted in themselves as just and despised others, he spoke also this parable: Two men went up into the temple to pray: the one a Pharisee and the other a publican.
And he was teaching in their synagogue on their sabbath. And behold there was a woman who had a spirit of infirmity eighteen years. And she was bowed together: neither could she look upwards at all.
He said therefore: To what is the kingdom of God like, and whereunto shall I resemble it?
And seeing the multitudes, he went up into a mountain, and when he was set down, his disciples came unto him.

celebration.en: The Commemoration of All the Faithful Departed (All Souls' Day)
celebration.es: Conmemoración de todos los fieles difuntos

verse.en: And it came to pass, when Jesus went into the house of one of the chief of the Pharisees, on the sabbath day, to eat bread, that they watched him. And behold, there was a certain man before him that had the dropsy.
And it came to pass, when Jesus went into the house of one of the chief of the Pharisees, on the sabbath day, to eat bread, that they watched him.
And entering he walked through Jericho. And behold, there was a man named Zacheus, who was the chief of the publicans: and he was rich.

And he said to him also that had invited him: When thou makest a dinner or a supper, call not thy friends nor thy brethren nor thy kinsmen nor thy neighbours who are rich; lest perhaps they also invite thee again…

When one of them that sat at table with him had heard these things, he said to him: Blessed is he that shall eat bread in the kingdom of God. But he said to him: A certain man made a great supper and invited many.
And there went great multitudes with him.

celebration.en: The Dedication of the Lateran Basilica
celebration.es: Dedicación de la Basílica de Letrán

verse.en: And the pasch of the Jews was at hand: and Jesus went up to Jerusalem. And he found in the temple them that sold oxen and sheep and doves, and the changers of money sitting.

celebration.en: Saint Leo the Great, Pope and Doctor of the Church
celebration.es: San León Magno, Papa y doctor de la Iglesia

verse.en: And he said also to his disciples: There was a certain rich man who had a steward: and the same was accused unto him, that he had wasted his goods. And he called him and said to him: How is it that I hear this of thee?
And I say to you: Make unto you friends of the mammon of iniquity: that when you shall fail, they may receive you into everlasting dwellings.

And there came to him some of the Sadducees, who deny that there is any resurrection: and they asked him, Saying: Master, Moses wrote unto us: If any man’s brother die, having a wife, and he leave no children…
And he said to his disciples: It is impossible that scandals should not come. But woe to him through whom they come!
But which of you, having a servant ploughing or feeding cattle, will say to him, when he is come from the field: Immediately go. Sit down to meat.

And it came to pass, as he was going to Jerusalem, he passed through the midst of Samaria and Galilee. And as he entered into a certain town, there met him ten men that were lepers, who stood afar off.
And being asked by the Pharisees when the kingdom of God should come, he answered them and said: The kingdom of God cometh not with observation. Neither shall they say: Behold here, or behold there.
And as it came to pass in the days of Noe, so shall it be also in the days of the Son of man.
And he spoke also a parable to them, that we ought always to pray and not to faint, Saying: There was a judge in a certain city, who feared not God nor regarded man.

And some saying of the temple that it was adorned with goodly stones and gifts, he said: These things which you see, the days will come in which there shall not be left a stone upon a stone that shall not be thrown down.
Now it came to pass, when he drew nigh to Jericho, that a certain blind man sat by the way side, begging. And when he heard the multitude passing by, he asked what this meant.

celebration.en: The Presentation of the Blessed Virgin Mary
celebration.es: Presentación de la Bienaventurada Virgen María

verse.en: And entering he walked through Jericho. And behold, there was a man named Zacheus, who was the chief of the publicans: and he was rich.
As they were hearing these things, he added and spoke a parable, because he was nigh to Jerusalem and because they thought that the kingdom of God should immediately be manifested.
And when he drew near, seeing the city, he wept over it, saying: If thou also hadst known, and that in this thy day, the things that are to thy peace: but now they are hidden from thy eyes.

celebration.en: Saint Andrew Dũng-Lạc, Priest, and Companions, Martyrs
celebration.es: Santos Andrés Dũng-Lạc, presbítero, y compañeros, mártires

verse.en: And entering into the temple, he began to cast out them that sold therein and them that bought. Saying to them: It is written: My house is the house of prayer. But you have made it a den of thieves.

And there came to him some of the Sadducees, who deny that there is any resurrection: and they asked him, Saying: Master, Moses wrote unto us: If any man’s brother die, having a wife, and he leave no children…

celebration.en: Our Lord Jesus Christ, King of the Universe
celebration.es: Nuestro Señor Jesucristo, Rey del Universo

verse.en: And the people stood beholding. And the rulers with them derided him, saying: He saved others: let him save himself, if he be Christ, the elect of God.
And looking on, he saw the rich men cast their gifts into the treasury. And he saw also a certain poor widow casting in two brass mites.

And some saying of the temple that it was adorned with goodly stones and gifts, he said: These things which you see, the days will come in which there shall not be left a stone upon a stone that shall not be thrown down.
But before all these things, they will lay their hands on you and persecute you, delivering you up to the synagogues and into prisons, dragging you before kings and governors, for my name’s sake.
And Jesus walking by the sea of Galilee, saw two brethren, Simon who is called Peter, and Andrew his brother, casting a net into the sea (for they were fishers).
And he spoke to them a similitude.
And take heed to yourselves, lest perhaps your hearts be overcharged with surfeiting and drunkenness and the cares of this life: and that day come upon you suddenly.
And as in the days of Noe, so shall also the coming of the Son of man be.
And when he had entered into Capharnaum, there came to him a centurion, beseeching him, And saying, Lord, my servant lieth at home sick of the palsy, and is grievously tormented.

In that same hour, he rejoiced in the Holy Ghost and said: I confess to thee, O Father, Lord of heaven and earth, because thou hast hidden these things from the wise and prudent and hast revealed them to little ones.
And when Jesus had passed away from thence, he came nigh the sea of Galilee: and going up into a mountain, he sat there.

celebration.en: Saint Ambrose, Bishop and Doctor of the Church
celebration.es: San Ambrosio, obispo y doctor de la Iglesia

verse.en: Not every one that saith to me, Lord, Lord, shall enter into the kingdom of heaven: but he that doth the will of my Father who is in heaven, he shall enter into the kingdom of heaven.

celebration.en: The Immaculate Conception of the Blessed Virgin Mary
celebration.es: Inmaculada Concepción de la Bienaventurada Virgen María

verse.en: And in the sixth month, the angel Gabriel was sent from God into a city of Galilee, called Nazareth, To a virgin espoused to a man whose name was Joseph, of the house of David: and the virgin’s name was Mary.
And Jesus went about all the cities and towns, teaching in their synagogues, and preaching the gospel of the kingdom, and healing every disease, and every infirmity.
And in those days cometh John the Baptist preaching in the desert of Judea. And saying: Do penance: for the kingdom of heaven is at hand.
And it came to pass on a certain day, as he sat teaching, that there were also Pharisees and doctors of the law sitting by, that were come out of every town of Galilee and Judea and Jerusalem…

And in the sixth month, the angel Gabriel was sent from God into a city of Galilee, called Nazareth, To a virgin espoused to a man whose name was Joseph, of the house of David: and the virgin’s name was Mary.
Come to me all you that labor and are burdened, and I will refresh you. Take up my yoke upon you, and learn of me, because I am meek, and humble of heart: And you shall find rest to your souls.

celebration.en: Saint John of the Cross, Priest and Doctor of the Church
celebration.es: San Juan de la Cruz, presbítero y doctor de la Iglesia

verse.en: Amen I say to you, there hath not risen among them that are born of women a greater than John the Baptist: yet he that is the lesser in the kingdom of heaven is greater than he.
But whereunto shall I esteem this generation to be like? It is like to children sitting in the market place.
And as they came down from the mountain, Jesus charged them, saying: Tell the vision to no man, till the Son of man be risen from the dead.
Now when John had heard in prison the works of Christ: sending two of his disciples he said to him: Art thou he that art to come, or look we for another?
Now the generation of Christ was in this wise. When as his mother Mary was espoused to Joseph, before they came together, she was found with child, of the Holy Ghost.
There was in the days of Herod, the king of Judea, a certain priest named Zachary, of the course of Abia: and his wife was of the daughters of Aaron, and her name Elizabeth.

And in the sixth month, the angel Gabriel was sent from God into a city of Galilee, called Nazareth, To a virgin espoused to a man whose name was Joseph, of the house of David: and the virgin’s name was Mary.
And Mary rising up in those days, went into the hill country with haste into a city of Juda. And she entered into the house of Zachary and saluted Elizabeth.

And Mary said: My soul doth magnify the Lord. And my spirit hath rejoiced in God my Saviour. Because he hath regarded the humility of his handmaid: for behold from henceforth all generations shall call me blessed.

Now Elizabeth’s full time of being delivered was come: and she brought forth a son. And her neighbors and kinsfolks heard that the Lord had shewed his great mercy towards her: and they congratulated with her.
Now the generation of Christ was in this wise. When as his mother Mary was espoused to Joseph, before they came together, she was found with child, of the Holy Ghost.
In the beginning was the Word: and the Word was with God: and the Word was God. The same was in the beginning with God. All things were made by him: and without him was made nothing that was made.
But beware of men. For they will deliver you up in councils, and they will scourge you in their synagogues.
And on the first day of the week, Mary Magdalen cometh early, when it was yet dark, unto the sepulchre: and she saw the stone taken away from the sepulchre.
And after they were departed, behold an angel of the Lord appeared in sleep to Joseph, saying: Arise, and take the child and his mother, and fly into Egypt: and be there until I shall tell thee.
And after the days of her purification, according to the law of Moses, were accomplished, they carried him to Jerusalem, to present him to the Lord: As it is written in the law of the Lord…
And there was one Anna, a prophetess, the daughter of Phanuel, of the tribe of Aser. She was far advanced in years and had lived with her husband seven years from her virginity.

celebration.en: The Holy Family of Jesus, Mary and Joseph
celebration.es: Sagrada Familia de Jesús, María y José

verse.en: And after they were departed, behold an angel of the Lord appeared in sleep to Joseph, saying: Arise, and take the child and his mother, and fly into Egypt: and be there until I shall tell thee.
